gate_objections: part 3 (pages 39-65): CTOB.04: the printed interviewer note that defines e-cigarettes is missing from the question text. part 3 (pages 39-65): CIMM.02: the Refused code is printed as '09 / 9999', but the inventory gives value 99999 and a label that says 'printed code 099999'. The value does not match the printed code (leading zero lost, and it is not a six-digit code like the Don't know value 777777). The printed codes should be kept consistent.

part 3 (pages 39-65): CALC.01n: this question is not printed in the source (the builder says so itself). The count slot belongs to CALC.01, so the extra id adds a question the part does not contain. Record the count within CALC.01 instead.

part 5 (pages 92-117): MSOGI.01 / MSOGI.02 routing is recorded with the wrong leaving question. The source gates sit before the question: 'If sex = male … continue, otherwise go to MSOGI.02' precedes MSOGI.01, and 'If sex = female … otherwise go to MSOGI.03' precedes MSOGI.02. The inventory records the jump 'not male → MSOGI.02' as leaving MSOGI.01, and 'not female → MSOGI.03' as leaving MSOGI.02. A respondent who fails the gate never answers the leaving question, so these jumps can never fire. The extra jump 'male → MSOGI.03' from MSOGI.01 is not printed in the source. Record the gate jumps from the real leaving point (the module prologue or the preceding question), or drop the redundant jump entries and keep only the conditions.

part 5 (pages 92-117): MHPV.01 has the same problem. The age gate 'To be asked of respondents between the ages of 18 and 49 … otherwise go to next module' is printed before MHPV.01. The inventory records it as a jump leaving MHPV.01 with condition age outside 18-49, which cannot fire for someone who never reaches MHPV.01. The gate also appears again as a condition on MHPV.01 and MHPV.02. Record it once, from the correct leaving point.

part 5 (pages 92-117): External questions CP05 and LL09 are given an invented code ('Value as coded in core') that the source does not print. Their coding is not given in this part, so the code entry should be removed rather than made up.

part 6 (pages 117-127): MRCS.05: the option codes are not the printed ones. The source prints 10, 20, 30, 40, 41-47, 50-54, 60, 88, 77 and 99, but the inventory gives each option a made-up bit-flag value (1, 2, 4, 8 … 524288) and moves the printed code into the label. Use the printed codes as the code values (10 White, 20 Black or African American, and so on), keeping 88, 77 and 99.
